help.title: Help and Support
help.q1: How do I change my profile picture?
help.a1: Go to the 'User Profile' screen and tap the circle with your photo or icon. You can select a new photo from your gallery.
help.q2: How do I update my name and surname?
help.a2: On the 'User Profile' screen, select the 'Edit Profile' option. You can modify your name and surname in the form that appears.
help.q3: How can I change my password?
help.a3: You can change your password from the 'User Profile' screen by selecting the 'Change Password' option.
help.q4: Where can I see my saved analyses?
help.a4: The 'Analysis' section in the main menu contains your entire history of wine analyses.
help.q5: Is it possible to export my data?
help.a5: We are currently working on a feature to export your data. It will be available very soon!
